Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

Provided is a heat treatment apparatus capable of being configured to be more compact. A heat treatment apparatus 1 includes a coolant passage defining body 42 to define a coolant passage 48 to supply a coolant to a workpiece 100. The coolant passage defining body 42 includes an upper member 50 and a lower member 40 as a plurality of coolant passage defining members, and is configured so that, by displacing these members 49 and 50 so as to approach each other along an up-down direction Z1 crossing a conveyance direction, the coolant passage 48 is defined in a state housing the workpiece 100. In addition, the coolant passage defining body is configured so that, by displacing the members 49 and 50 described above so as to separate from each other along the up-down direction Z1, the workpiece 100 is allowed to be let into and out of the coolant passage 48 along the conveyance direction A1.

outputs.L3:
The heat treatment apparatus includes a coolant passage defining body that forms a coolant passage for supplying coolant to a workpiece. The coolant passage defining body is configured to guide coolant to the workpiece during heat treatment, thereby enabling the workpiece to be cooled in a controlled manner.

The coolant passage defining body includes an upper member and a lower member. These members cooperate with each other to define the coolant passage. More specifically, when the upper member and the lower member are brought into a predetermined positional relationship, they together form a passage through which coolant can flow around or toward the workpiece.

The upper member and the lower member are movable relative to each other in an up-down direction. This up-down direction crosses, for example intersects, a conveyance direction in which the workpiece is conveyed. When the workpiece is to be cooled, the upper member and the lower member move toward each other along the up-down direction. By moving toward each other, the upper and lower members house the workpiece between them and form the coolant passage for supplying coolant to the workpiece.

On the other hand, when the workpiece is to be introduced into or removed from the coolant passage, the upper member and the lower member move away from each other along the up-down direction. This separated state provides an opening or clearance that allows the workpiece to enter and exit the coolant passage along the conveyance direction without interference from the coolant passage defining body.

With this configuration, the coolant passage is formed only when the upper and lower members are moved toward each other, and the passage is opened when the members are moved apart. As a result, the apparatus does not require a long fixed coolant passage or a large space for loading and unloading the workpiece. Therefore, the heat treatment apparatus can be configured more compactly while still enabling efficient supply of coolant to the workpiece.
outputs.L4:
A compact heat treatment apparatus is provided for performing cooling treatment on a workpiece that is conveyed through the apparatus. The apparatus includes an upper coolant passage member and a lower coolant passage member arranged respectively above and below a conveyance path of the workpiece. These coolant passage members are configured to move vertically toward and away from each other. When the workpiece reaches a predetermined treatment position, the upper and lower coolant passage members move closer together to define a coolant passage surrounding or substantially enclosing the workpiece. Coolant is then supplied through the coolant passage so that the workpiece can be efficiently cooled while being housed between the coolant passage members.

After the cooling treatment is completed, the upper and lower coolant passage members move apart from each other, opening the conveyance path. This allows the treated workpiece to be easily discharged and permits the next workpiece to enter the treatment position without obstruction. Because the coolant passage is formed only when needed around the workpiece and does not require a large fixed cooling chamber, the overall structure of the apparatus can be made smaller. As a result, the apparatus enables effective heat treatment and cooling while improving workpiece loading and unloading performance and contributing to a more compact equipment design.

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a patent-style summary for an invention involving a compact heat treatment apparatus where a coolant passage defining body has upper and lower members that approach each other vertically to house a workpiece and separate to let the workpiece enter and exit along a conveyance direction.
counterfactuals.output:
A compact heat treatment apparatus is provided for efficiently heating and cooling a workpiece while reducing installation space and simplifying workpiece transfer. The apparatus includes a coolant passage defining body configured to form a coolant passage around or adjacent to a workpiece during heat treatment. The coolant passage defining body includes an upper member and a lower member arranged to be movable relative to each other in a vertical direction.

In operation, the upper member and the lower member are moved toward each other to define a treatment space for accommodating the workpiece and to establish a coolant passage through which a cooling medium is supplied during a cooling process. The workpiece may be heated before, during, or after being positioned between the upper and lower members, and may then be rapidly cooled by the coolant flowing through the coolant passage. After completion of the heat treatment, the upper member and the lower member are separated vertically, thereby opening the treatment space and permitting the workpiece to enter or exit the apparatus along a conveyance direction.

Because the workpiece is introduced and discharged in the conveyance direction while the coolant passage defining body opens and closes in the vertical direction, the apparatus can be incorporated into a linear conveyance line with a compact footprint. The vertical approach-and-separation structure also allows the coolant passage to be formed close to the workpiece during treatment, improving cooling efficiency and uniformity, while avoiding interference with conveyance of the workpiece when the apparatus is open.

Accordingly, the invention enables a compact heat treatment apparatus capable of accommodating a workpiece, performing controlled cooling through a defined coolant passage, and allowing smooth loading and unloading of the workpiece along a conveyance path.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft the “Problem/Solution” summary paragraph for a patent application about a heat treatment apparatus that supplies coolant to a workpiece using movable coolant passage defining members, enabling a more compact configuration.
counterfactuals.output: Conventional heat treatment apparatuses that cool a heated workpiece typically require fixed coolant supply structures, enlarged coolant chambers, or extensive piping arranged around the workpiece, which can increase the overall size of the apparatus and limit layout flexibility. To address this problem, the disclosed heat treatment apparatus includes coolant passage defining members that are movable relative to the workpiece and are configured to define, at least during cooling, coolant passages for supplying coolant toward the workpiece. By moving the coolant passage defining members into an operative position when coolant is to be supplied, and moving them away or repositioning them as needed, the coolant flow path can be formed close to the workpiece without requiring a large permanently fixed coolant supply space. As a result, coolant can be efficiently delivered to the workpiece while enabling a more compact apparatus configuration.

An upper member and a lower member move toward each other in a vertical direction to form a treatment space around the workpiece for heat treatment, while the coolant passage body circulates coolant through the coolant passage to control temperature.
